name: manual_00f3e0
claim: Never trust reanchor_scan.sh's NEEDS-REANCHOR verdict alone as unmerged work — after a squash-merge, individual commit patch-ids never match main even though all content landed. Confirm with git diff main..<branch> --stat (near-empty = fully absorbed) plus git log main --grep for the absorbing squash-merge commit title before concluding a branch has real unmerged content.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-22 branch cleanup audit: reanchor_scan.sh flagged 13 branches across orama-system + Perpetua-Tools as NEEDS-REANCHOR. Individually verifying each via diff+log-grep found ALL were already fully superseded by squash-merges (PR #146, #142, #183, #203, #211, #258-267, #260/#263) -- zero actually contained unmerged unique work. Trusting the scan's raw verdict would have wrongly treated finished, reviewed work as still-pending.
